**Summary**
Describe your idea in 1-2 sentences.

**Details**
Give a detailed description of the feature. Anything helps. Expected behavior, use cases you want to use this for, other DAWs that already have that feature as references, whatever comes to mind...

**Name Suggestions**
If you have any creative and fun ideas for a name (like Gluerip), tell us. :)
